# netactuate_network_loadbalancer_group (Resource)

Manages a Network Loadbalancer Group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_network_loadbalancer_group" "example" {
  algorithm = "round_robin"
  backend {
    internal_address = "192.0.2.10"
    name             = "example"
  }
  health_check {
    delay    = 80
    enabled  = true
    interval = 80
    method   = "tcp"
    retries  = 1
    timeout  = 80
  }
  ip_version              = 4
  match_address           = "192.0.2.10"
  name                    = "example"
  network_loadbalancer_id = 12345
  rule {
    port_internal = 80
    port_match    = 80
    protocol      = "TCP"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `algorithm` (String) Load balancing algorithm (e.g. round-robin)
- `backend` (Block List, Min: 1) Backend servers (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--backend))
- `health_check` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) Health check configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--health_check))
- `ip_version` (Number) IP version (4 or 6)
- `match_address` (String) Public IP address to match incoming traffic
- `name` (String) Name of the load balancer group
- `network_loadbalancer_id` (Number) The ID of the network load balancer
- `rule` (Block List, Min: 1) Forwarding rules (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the load balancer group

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_online` (Boolean) Whether the group is online
- `network_group_id` (Number) The group ID assigned by the API

<a id="nestedblock--backend"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backend`

Required:

- `internal_address` (String) Internal IP address of the backend
- `name` (String) Name of the backend

Read-Only:

- `is_online` (Boolean) Whether this backend is online
- `network_backend_id` (Number) The backend ID assigned by the API


<a id="nestedblock--health_check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_check`

Required:

- `delay` (Number) Delay between retries in seconds
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether health checks are enabled
- `interval` (Number) Health check interval in seconds
- `method` (String) Health check method (e.g. Ping)
- `retries` (Number) Number of retries before marking unhealthy
- `timeout` (Number) Health check timeout in seconds


<a id="nestedblock--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Required:

- `port_internal` (Number) Internal port to forward to
- `port_match` (Number) External port to match
- `protocol` (String) Protocol (e.g. TCP, UDP)

Read-Only:

- `network_rule_id` (Number) The rule ID assigned by the API

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_network_loadbalancer_group.example 12345
```
